filo_ambulance.description:
- Add EMS **Set recovery** on a patient: they limp for the minutes the medic picks, even after their wounds are treated. **End recovery** or `/heal` stops it early. Configure it in `Config.recovery`
- Add the `getRecoveryTime` client export
- Add four painkillers to the pharmacy and `Config.painRelief`: `acetaminophen`, `naproxen`, `lidocaine` and `ketorolac`
- Add `theme` to `Config.branding`: `'chrome'` (default) for the liquid chrome look, `'colour'` for your own accent and background
- Rework the UI in the Filo liquid chrome look: graphite surfaces, silver chrome buttons and highlights, upright sentence-case text, no glows, gradients or scanlines
- Change the default `accent` and `background` to the liquid chrome colours (`#D9DBE0` / `#141415`). Set your own colours in the branding config to keep your look
- Change the default server name to `FILO SCRIPTS`
- Change the German, French, Greek, Italian, Portuguese and Swedish translations to cover the new options

filo_bolt.description: - Fix player collision and movement during camera use

filo_stealwheels.description:
- Introduced `cl-editable.lua` for custom minigame support.
- Added tire iron item definition and durability mechanics.
- Updated `WHEEL_BONES` constants with offsets.
- Added server callbacks for attaching wheels and updating tool durability.

filo_ui.description:
- **Breaking:** The server notification event is now `filo_ui:notify`. Replace `krs_notify:Alert` with `filo_ui:notify` in your own scripts
- Change all pause menu fonts and scaleform names to the `filo_` prefix

filo_vehiclekeys.description:
- Resolve vehicle entity handling issues in ignition keybind.
- Ensure vehicle source is assigned during creation.
- Add entity validation in server-side utility.
